slides.title:
islamic ways to
soften a hard heart
slides.sub:
From the Qur'an & Sunnah, for the days
your heart feels like stone

slides.title: #1 polish the rust
slides.sub: Every sin leaves a mark. Every return wipes it.

quote.text: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

body: The Prophet ﷺ explained it: a sin leaves a black spot on the heart. Stop, seek forgiveness and repent, and it is polished clean. Keep going back, and it spreads. *(Tirmidhi 3334, hasan)*
Don't let the spots pile up. Say astaghfirullah tonight, and mean it.

slides.title: #2 remember Him often
slides.sub: A restless heart is usually a heart that forgot.

quote.text: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.

body: Not once a day. Often: on the bus, between tasks, before you sleep.
Tie one dhikr to something you already do, like *SubhanAllah* every time you unlock your phone.

slides.title: #3 visit the graves
slides.sub: Nothing shrinks the dunya back to size faster.

quote.text: ...so visit the graves, for that makes you mindful of death.

body: Go with a friend. Give salam to the people there and make du'a for them. Then look at your worries again. Most of them shrink back to their real size.
